quests.title: Flower Field
quests.about: Frieren is trying to cast the spell that makes a field of flowers. It's a useless spell in a fight, and it's the one Himmel loved most. She can't get the bloom right.

endings.title: See the bloom
endings.about: Frieren casts the flower spell, and the petals come up around the library steps. She says Himmel always said it looked like someone had been careful, and she thinks he'd be pleased.

quests.title: The Statue
quests.about: Frieren takes Fern to the statue of Himmel, the hero who beat the Demon King. Frieren says she never got to know him well, and she wants Fern to understand that a spell is also a way of remembering someone.
offer: them: I'm taking Fern to the hero's statue tonight. I want her to understand what a spell is for.
them (pleased): Fern is a little too careful. Beat her in a practice duel first, so she knows what it costs to hold a spell steady.

endings.title: Keep the statue
endings.about: Frieren leaves a candle at the statue with Fern, and tells her one story about Himmel that she never told anyone. Fern asks what she should have asked him, and Frieren says the same thing she has been regretting for years.

quests.title: Aureole
quests.about: Frieren has the chance to travel to Aureole, where souls rest, and speak to Himmel once more. She never took that road when he was alive, and she has to decide whether to go now, and say what she never said.

quests.title: Tail Meat
quests.about: Tohru is a dragon who wants to cook tail meat for Kobayashi, because she thinks it's a way of showing she loves her. She's loud about it, and the meat is always slightly on fire.

quests.title: Chaos Dragon

endings.title: Keep the mask
endings.about: Joker gives you a plain mask for the night, and says it's yours to wear when you need to be someone else. He says he's glad to have a regular who doesn't ask for the name.

quests.title: Calling Card

quests.title: Zombie Idol

endings.title: Hold the arm
endings.about: Ollie's arm comes off during the chorus, and she hands it to you with a grin. She says it's a good sign, and she'll sing the next verse with one hand, to prove she's still got the rhythm.

quests.title: Graveyard Shift
